findings.desc: Required smoke evidence is not runnable in REVIEW: npm --prefix packages/main run test:cli-surface-smoke fails because the invalid checklist_update probe at packages/main/src/tasks/cli-surface-smoke.ts:160 runs with --root repoRoot while story B-a776 is in REVIEW, so the phase gate emits Command "checklist_update" is not available in REVIEW phase before the validation path. This invalidates the CHK-003 happy/edge smoke evidence for reviewer/TEST execution and leaves the advertised Argument validation failed path unproven in the active lifecycle phase.

packages/main/src/tasks/cli-surface-smoke.ts:160-182: the new test:cli-surface-smoke verification is not phase-stable. In REVIEW, npm --prefix packages/main run test:cli-surface-smoke fails because the invalid checklist_update probe is phase-gated before argument validation, printing Command checklist_update is not available in REVIEW phase instead of Argument validation failed. This means the parser/help/alias extraction evidence cannot be rerun from REVIEW/TEST and the adversarial validation check is coupled to lifecycle dispatch state; use a phase-neutral command/root or isolate the validation-path assertion from the active story phase gate.
